---
title: "`r page_desc`"
output: 
  distill::distill_article:
    toc: true
---

```{r Subset Checklist documents for BS, echo = F, results="asis"}
checklist_items <- subset(
  x = task_list_data,
  subset = sub_page == page_desc
)

# generating excel checklists by person
printables <- checklist_items %>% 
  pivot_longer(fpc_task:sl_task, names_to = "leader", values_to = "done") %>%
  filter(done == "T") %>%
  mutate(person = case_when(
    leader == "fpc_task" ~ "FPC",
    leader == "dl_task" ~ "Deck Lead",
    leader == "sl_task" ~ "Safety Lead"
  )) %>%
  select(Category = section, Task = title, Items = subtitle, person) %>%
  arrange(Category, Task, Items) %>%
  split(.$person)

for(i in 1:length(printables)){
  printables[[i]] %>%
    select(-person) %>%
    writexl::write_xlsx(paste0("../data/", page_desc, "_", names(printables)[i], ".xlsx"))
  
  cat(paste0("[Excel tasklist for ", names(printables)[i], "](../data/", page_desc, "_", names(printables)[i], ".xlsx)"))
  cat("\n \n")
}

cat("\n \n")

tabl <- checklist_items %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ord = case_when(
    fpc_task == "T" ~ 1,
    fpc_task == "T" & dl_task == "T" & sl_task == "F" ~ 2,
    fpc_task == "T" & dl_task == "T" & sl_task == "T" ~ 3,
    fpc_task == "T" & sl_task == "T" & dl_task == "F" ~ 4,
    dl_task == "T" ~ 4,
    dl_task == "T" & sl_task == "T" & fpc_task == "F" ~ 5,
    sl_task == "T" ~ 6
  )) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(sub_page, section, ord) %>%
  group_by(section) %>%
  mutate(n = cumsum(!duplicated(title))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    title = ifelse(!is.na(url_loc) & is.na(subtitle),
      paste0(n, ". [", title, "](", url_loc, ")"), paste0(n, ". ", title)
    ),
    subtitle = ifelse(!is.na(url_loc) & !is.na(subtitle),
      paste0("[", subtitle, "](", url_loc, ")"), subtitle
    ),
    subtitle = ifelse(is.na(subtitle), "", paste0(" - ", subtitle))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace(., . == "T", "X"))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace(., . == "F", ""))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(section, title, subtitle, fpc_task, dl_task, sl_task) %>%
  split(.$section)


section <- names(x = tabl)
for (i in 1:length(section)) {
  cat(paste("# ", section[i]), "\n\n")

  g <- tabl[[i]] %>% dplyr::select(-section)
  cols <- seq((ncol(g) - 2), ncol(g))

  cat(
    knitr::kable(g,
      col.names = c("Task", "", "FPC", "Deck Lead", "Safety Lead"),
      format = "html", linesep = "", booktabs = T,
      align = c("l", "l", "c", "c", "c"),
      table.attr = "style='width:125%;'"
    ) %>%
      kable_styling("basic", "hold_position", wraptable_width = "10pt") %>%
      column_spec(cols, width = "0.5in", extra_css = "vertical-align:top;") %>%
      column_spec(2, width = "2.5in", extra_css = "vertical-align:top;") %>%
      column_spec(1, width = "3in", extra_css = "vertical-align:top;") %>%
      kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top")
  )

  cat("\n \n \n")
}

rm(checklist_items, g, tabl, section)
```
